body.name: bc
body.type: For each \(c\), a positive rational vector indexed by external-parent contexts and child outputs.
body.def: For a topological order \(V_1,\ldots,V_m\), \(b_c[e,v_c]=\prod_{i:V_i\in C_c}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(V_i=v_i\mid V_1=v_1,\ldots,V_{i-1}=v_{i-1})\), evaluated at the assignment matching \((e,v_c)\).
